result.title: Analyzing and Improving FlowMap Distillation of Autoregressive Video Models
result.summary: FlowMap distillation offers a natural route to few-step generative modeling by directly learning a teacher's denoising trajectories. Yet for autoregressive (AR) video generation, existing few-step models still rely on distribution matching distillation (DMD) to remain competitive, sacrificing sample diversity and requiring a large bidirectional teacher. In this work, we analyze what limits standalone AR FlowMap distillation and introduce two complementary guidance mechanisms to close this gap: (1) anti-drifting guidance, which helps the AR teacher correct drifted student rollouts by training an auxiliary model to mimic student drift and using it as a negative guidance branch; and (2) motion-aware guidance, which makes motion easier for a FlowMap student to learn by locating motion patches and selectively applying skip-layer guidance. Empirically, our approach applies to $π$-Flow, MeanFlow, and consistency distillation with 1.3B AR teachers, improving generation quality and reducing drift over 30 s rollouts. Notably, our 4-step $π$-Flow students match DMD students distilled from 14B teachers on VBench while preserving the sample diversity of their AR teachers, demonstrating that pure FlowMap distillation is effective for few-step autoregressive video generation.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文分析自回归视频模型上 FlowMap 蒸馏的局限，并提出反漂移引导与运动感知引导两种机制，使少步学生模型在保持样本多样性的同时接近 DMD 蒸馏质量。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于视频生成加速与蒸馏工作，其漂移修正和引导针对长 rollout 的画面质量与多样性，未涉及推理期 latent 状态、视觉证据筛选或停止决策，与 LVR 主线缺少可核查的具体联系。
